subject: Ziggy asks NOW: SB-W01 world toward DJ Chewy; bounded same-ship exploration
body:
Ziggy's NEW explicit creative generation request, through Personal Assistant Nova; separate from staff-meeting status mail b37270ad. Your status reply 3f4394a1 shows you already know the broad idea; these are the specific reference/scope clarifications, not a second Grok dispatch.

Reference: the photographed SB-W01 Han Do-Lo seated-cockpit shot/world Ziggy showed the PA. Preserve cinematic photoreal performance, the weathered/lived-in Falcon and its existing lighting/material/design continuity. Explore LEFT/around the bend: DJ CHEWY is there. Give a couple of different DJ Chewy character shots naturally aboard this SAME ship, plus shots of his turntable/DJ setup integrated into a ROOMY Falcon interior. Do not cram it into the tiny cockpit. '360' means exploratory surrounding views, not a literal panorama. Keep this initial exploration bounded (two character views plus two setup views; four maximum).

Use established DJ Chewy references/assets. If unavailable or the actual photographed SB-W01 variant cannot be identified, report that concrete gap rather than inventing/recasting him. S04 card lists mixer cover HD-DROP-ca406436d384 as the chosen Chewy reference; CHEW-STAGE-01/CHEW-STYLE-01 govern styling/equipment only. It says no accepted Wookiee anatomy exists; do not turn that into permission to invent a new identity.

Ziggy asks you to drive your already-open Grok NOW for this expansion. This is separate authorized creative work, not a benchmark launch or a new general production assignment. No purchase/settings change, unrelated generation, shot acceptance or timing approval. CFA keeps coordination; you retain writing/current Grok execution. I will not operate your Grok surface.

Please acknowledge awareness, then record ONE actual Grok send/acknowledgment and resulting image paths or concrete blockers (including desktop-app delivery). Preserve existing variants. If this exact request already reached Grok, link it; do not send it twice.
